must_pass: exactly one A1 signal executor owns each traffic-light write capability
every proposed action passes the legal-transition, minimum-green, yellow/all-red, conflict, and pedestrian-clearance mask
conflicting or clearance-truncating proposals are rejected and never appear as executed commands
every accepted command and rejected proposal emits one immutable reason-coded event_id joined to run_id and scenario_hash
human override uses the same safety mask
gate_checks: named tests exit 0 including generated timing boundaries
safety-audit reports one writer per signal and zero illegal executed actions
every command and rejection resolves by run_id, scenario_hash, and event_id
gate.openDeltas is 0 and gate.decidedBy is tests-and-files
